## EcrecoverRatifierRatifyParams type

Parameters for [EcrecoverRatifierUtils.ratify()](./midnight-sdk.ecrecoverratifierutils.ratify.md)<!-- -->.

Use this after tree validation. Provide either a signing client plus account or a precomputed signature plus the account that produced it.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type EcrecoverRatifierRatifyParams = {
    readonly tree: RatifierTreeInput;
    readonly client: Client<Transport, Chain, Account | undefined>;
    readonly account: Account | Address;
    readonly signature?: undefined;
} | {
    readonly tree: RatifierTreeInput;
    readonly signature: EcrecoverSignatureInput;
    readonly account: Account | Address;
    readonly client?: undefined;
    readonly chainId?: undefined;
};
```
**References:** [RatifierTreeInput](./midnight-sdk.ratifiertreeinput.md)<!-- -->, [EcrecoverSignatureInput](./midnight-sdk.ecrecoversignatureinput.md)
